# PSEPHEDA - University of Macedonia Digital Repository

> > PSEPHEDA is the institutional repository and digital library of the University of Macedonia, providing open access to academic research, theses, and digitized materials.

PSEPHEDA (Ψηφιδά) is a DSpace-based institutional repository operated by the University of Macedonia Library in Greece. It serves as a centralized platform for managing, preserving, and providing open access to the university's academic output, including dissertations, theses, research papers, and digitized materials, in compliance with open access principles and the Berlin Declaration.

## Core Repository Access

- [PSEPHEDA: Home](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr): PSEPHEDA digital library and institutional repository homepage for University of Macedonia
- [PSEPHEDA: Institutional Repository](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/6): Main institutional repository page with open access and Berlin Declaration compliance
- [PSEPHEDA: Communities and Collections](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/community-list): Browse communities and collections in PSEPHEDA institutional repository
- [PSEPHEDA: Browsing Psepheda](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/browse): Browse and discover content in PSEPHEDA digital repository by title and index

## Academic Collections

- [PSEPHEDA: PhD Dissertations](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/124): PhD dissertations collection in institutional repository with submission guidelines
- [PSEPHEDA: Master's Theses](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/125): Master's theses collection in PSEPHEDA institutional repository
- [PSEPHEDA: Undergraduate Final Papers](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/126): Undergraduate final papers collection from University of Macedonia departments

## Digital Collections

- [PSEPHEDA: Digital Library](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/20726): Digital library collection featuring digitized academic materials and open access
- [PSEPHEDA: Accessible Digital Materials for Print-Disabled Students](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/123): Accessible digital materials for print-disabled students with assistive technology

## User Accounts & Authentication

- [PSEPHEDA: Log In](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/mydspace): PSEPHEDA login portal with authentication and password reset support
- [PSEPHEDA: User Profile](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/profile): User profile and institutional account authentication for PSEPHEDA

## Documentation & Support

- [DSpace Help](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/help/index.html): DSpace user guide covering search, browse, submission, and account management
- [PSEPHEDA: Feedback](https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/feedback): Feedback submission portal for PSEPHEDA with user authentication
